integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible finite NumPy checks. Self-review correctness, originality and value review passed; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical renewal resetting to a fixed density matrix after unitary steps, all finite dimensions at least two and all finite times with positive survival. Claims only the Schrödinger single-time evolution. Increasing hazard is sufficient, not necessary. Does not address nonunitary dynamics, certain-reset ages, Heisenberg divisibility or full temporal-process Markovianity.
title: An operator-order test and rising-hazard protection for unitary quantum resetting
